Isopropyl 6- (benzyloxy)-4-(methoxymethyl)-9H-pyrido(3,4-b)indole-3-car- boxylate. Абекарнил C24H24N2O4 = 404.5. CAS — 111841-85-1. Profile Abecarnil is a beta-carboline compound reported to be a partial agonist at benzodiazepine receptors. It has been studied for its anxiolytic and anticonvulsant actions in anxiety disorders and al- cohol withdrawal syndrome. ◊ References. 1. Krause W, et al. Pharmacokinetics and acute toleration of the β- carboline derivative abecarnil in man. Arzneimittelforschung 1990; 40: 529–32. 2. Karara AH, et al.
